Kṛnmañjarī
gr. 18 Kārikās on Kṛt suffixes of the Kātantra school. by Śivadāsa or Śivarāma Śarman (Vācaspati) or Śivarāmadāsa Śarman, son of Gopīramaṇa Cakravartin.
For a list of authorities cited by him, see RASB. VI. 4403.
Dacca 164. C. 416. G. 450. F. 455. D. 524. H (inc.). 660. F. 1248 (with C.). 1447. B. 1544. 2069. C. 2. 3240. 3375 (fr.). IO. 784. RASB. VI. 4402 (with C.). 4403. Vaṅgīya p. 163.
--C. by a. Dacca 1248. IO. 784. RASB. VI. 4402 (all three with text).
Pt.. (1) with a.'s C. Syamantaka Press, Dacca, 1886 (2nd edn.). (2) Calcutta, 1905-6. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 950. 985-86 an. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 1285. 1365.
